tagline.en: A vision-language-action policy for robot control, evaluated on the LIBERO benchmark.
tagline.zh: 面向机器人控制的视觉-语言-动作策略,在 LIBERO 基准上评测。

en: LIBERO-Para is a vision-language-action (VLA) policy geared toward the LIBERO robot-manipulation benchmark. It maps visual observations and instructions to robot actions for policy rollout and evaluation.
WorldFoundry runs it through an official-policy runtime adapter, fitting the shared inference flow. The checkpoint is hosted on Hugging Face and pulled in at run time.
In WorldFoundry you supply observations and it returns an action rollout, which you can score on the LIBERO benchmark tasks.
zh: LIBERO-Para 是面向 LIBERO 机器人操作基准的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)策略。它把视觉观测与指令映射为机器人动作,用于策略推演与评测。
WorldFoundry 通过官方策略运行时适配器运行它,契合统一的推理流程。Checkpoint 托管于 Hugging Face,在运行时载入。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你提供观测,它便返回动作推演,可在 LIBERO 基准任务上评分。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want a VLA policy to run and evaluate robot control on the LIBERO benchmark.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想用一个 VLA 策略在 LIBERO 基准上运行并评测机器人控制时,选它。

notFor.en: It is a control policy for benchmark evaluation, not a media generator. The checkpoint downloads separately, so stage it before running.
notFor.zh: 它是用于基准评测的控制策略,而非媒体生成器。Checkpoint 需单独下载,请在运行前先备好。

en: Runs through an official-policy runtime adapter
zh: 面向机器人控制的视觉-语言-动作策略
